 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Gray separators; the first panel of each band gives its ink color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sr = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] and v != 0 for v in grid[r])]
    sc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] and grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h))]
    r0s, r1s = [0]+[r+1 for r in sr], sr+[h]
    c0s, c1s = [0]+[c+1 for c in sc], sc+[w]
    marker = grid[sr[0]][0]
    # Find the embedded pattern, excluding the leftmost color-key column.
    shape = None
    for r0,r1 in zip(r0s,r1s):
        for c0,c1 in zip(c0s[1:],c1s[1:]):
            pts=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] not in (0,marker)]
            if pts:
                shape=pts
                break
        if shape: break
    if shape is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1 in zip(r0s,r1s):
        # key color in leftmost cell pattern
        key=next(grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0s[0],c1s[0]) if grid[r][c] not in (0,marker))
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(w):
                if c not in sc: out[r][c]=0
        for c0,c1 in zip(c0s,c1s):
            for dr,dc in shape: out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=key
    return out
```",
